sources.title: EfficientFormer: Vision Transformers at MobileNet Speed
sources.snippet: Vision Transformers (ViT) have shown rapid progress in computer vision tasks, achieving promising results on various benchmarks. However, due to the massive number of parameters and model design, \\textit{e.g.}, attention mechanism, ViT-based models are generally times slower than lightweight convolutional networks. sources.title: snap-research/EfficientFormer | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: EfficientFormer: Original models that pioneered vision transformers at MobileNet speed These models address the challenge of deploying transformer-based architectures on resource-constrained devices by optimizing both model size and inference speed while maintaining competitive accuracy.
